This lack of consistency led to a serious error with my medication. I ultimately had to contact the Practice Manager to get the issue resolved, which was a stressful and unnecessary ordeal.

It is frustrating to be moved from doctor to doctor without any stability. While the manager did eventually fix the mistake, I am not impressed with the overall management or the way patient handovers are handled. I hope to see improvements in how they manage patient records and staff changes in the future.
